Why does it happen in love?

Dharam Singh Dhillon / Dharam Oberoi / Yamla Baba
Gajodhar Singh / Prem Oberoi / Q. Oberoi
35213: A flapper who's secretly a good girl and a gold-digging floozy masquerading as an ingénue both vie for the hand of a millionaire.
THE JAZZ-MAD GIRL, THE JAZZ-MAD WHIRL: A romance of flaming youth, the children of the rich, and the jazz-mad age.
35469: Belgium, of all places. What's Belgium got besides chocolates and fries? 35981: A group of friends are going on a camping trip to celebrate graduating college. But once they enter the woods, the proverbial shit starts to hit the fan.
36237: Survivors of a sinking ship are rescued by Captain Nemo and his submarine crew. They are taken to an underwater city where they may spend the rest of their lives.
They tried to leave the golden city with the most valuable prize of all - their lives!
36493: An ex-con's future is threatened by his brother's involvement with drugs.

The king's right hand secretly wishes to take the throne and tries to kill the king, but the cursed king just would not die. Things only get worse when during the night a huge a concentration of Talibans begin surround them.
37773: In the not so distant future, a team of white collar criminals are enlisted by the Federal government to thwart a cyber-attack that threatens to bankrupt the United States of America.
It takes a criminal to catch a criminal

38285: Travel plans for three men go horribly wrong with a race against time to return Luke home.

38797: What sins did we commit in our past lives and will we pay for them in this one?
Be sure your sins will find you out

CHAN FACES HIS MOST DIABOLIC ENEMY!

What I can do for my country I am willing to do.

Hired Gunslinger In A Lawless Land!
